Operations Coordinator, Collections, Bilingual (Spanish-English)

About the role

Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind? We're hiring Bilingual (Spanish-English) Operations Coordinators for our Collections &amp; Recoveries team to have direct, honest conversations with customers every day about getting their accounts back on track, fairly and respectfully. The impact you'll make: A customer’s fallen behind on a credit card payment. They already know what they owe. What they don't know is whether taking our call means getting further behind, or getting somewhere. They need someone on the other end of the line who will tell them plainly what's owed and what their options are, listen to what's going on, and help them land on a plan that works for their life. As an Operations Coordinator on the Collections &amp; Recoveries team, you're that voice. Your job on every call is to be straightforward, be kind, and get to a plan that helps the cardholder move forward. As Operations Coordinator, you will: Speak with customers who've fallen behind on payment, understand their circumstances, and ask directly for what's owed, in full or through a workable payment plan. Work with customers through pushback and objections, staying patient and persistent as you build toward a plan that works for them. Follow established scripts, tools, and account guidelines to keep every conversation consistent, professional, and compliant. Read a conversation quickly and adjust your approach, always keeping the ask in view. Keep accurate, timely records of every call and outcome in our systems. Meet daily and weekly targets for collections, call quality, and productivity. Take coaching and feedback fast, and apply it on your very next call. Flag anything unusual (a complex account, a dispute, a technical issue) to your manager right away for guidance. Stay actively engaged with your team throughout your shift in Collaboration Room AI, our virtual, video-based team space where you and your teammates stay visible and connected in real time, the same way you would in a physical office. You'll thrive in this role if: You can be firm and fair in the same conversation. You're comfortable asking directly for payment and staying patient and persistent when a customer pushes back.
